title: writelines
summary: Write text lines to a file.

gpu_support.notes: Host-side text and filesystem operation; numeric resident inputs are rejected before provider access.

description: `writelines(lines, filename)` writes each supplied text value as a line in a host file.
behaviors: `lines` may be a string scalar, string array, character vector, or cell array of scalar text. String-array and cell elements are written in linear order.
`filename` must be scalar host text. Native integer and resident numeric inputs are rejected rather than converted to text.
RunMat writes a line ending after every input element, including the last. The `LineEnding` option accepts `"unix"`, `"windows"`, `"pc"`, or `"mac"`.
The current implementation overwrites the destination file. `WriteMode` and `Encoding` options are not yet implemented.

examples.description: Write a string array as separate lines

faqs.question: Does `writelines` gather GPU values?
faqs.answer: No. Its inputs are text and filesystem options, so numeric resident values are rejected before provider access.
